notes.title: Breath of Fresh Air - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fix for not counting undos
[*]Fix for navigating main menu using keyboard
[*]Fix for piece to have correct color and scale after an interaction with Mouse and Controller
[*]Fix for playing last piece animation when hitting more than 2 pieces in a row
[*]Fix for incorrect level text on complete puzzle menu
[*]Fix for skewed piece after playing no move animations
[*]Fix for completion time on complete puzzle menu to show time from start of level to puzzle completion instead start of level or last restart to puzzle completion
[*]Fix for typo in In-Game options menu
[*]Fix for “Next Level” button being available in puzzle complete menu after completing last puzzle in puzzle set while progression criteria is unmet
[*]Fix for UI navigation in the puzzle complete menu when the “Next Level” button is unavailable
[*]Fix for UI navigation in the puzzle complete menu when change input between mouse, controller, and keyboard
[*]Fix for puzzle complete menu showing incorrect number of levels to progress
[*]Fix for UI navigation in 100% menu
[/olist]

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Added ESC key control to all menus
[olist]
[*]Returns to previous menu in Main Menu
[*]Return to puzzle select or puzzle in puzzle completion menu
[/olist]
[*]Added backspace key as a way to Undo
[*]Added puzzle set select button to puzzle completion menu
[/olist]

notes.title: User Control Improvements
notes.content:
Changes and updates on how reset and undo function


[list]
[*] Changes to Reset 
[list]
[*] Added Reset Modes
[list]
[*] Control how you want the reset to be applied
[*] Options: Instant and Timed
[list]
[*] Instant - Apply reset immediately
[*] Timed - Apply reset after 3 seconds
[/list][/list][/list]
[*] Changes to Undo
[list]
[*] Change undo from accelerating over time to a constant speed
[*] Reduced initial undo speed from 0.2s to 0.15s
[/list]
[/list]

tags.balance_change: [*] Reduced initial undo speed from 0.2s to 0.15s
